props.name: children
props.description: Compose Accordion.Item elements in the desired order.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the item is expanded when initially rendered.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the item is expanded. Providing this prop makes the item controlled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the item requests a change to its expanded state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item cannot be expanded or collapsed.

props.name: children
props.description: The label for the accordion trigger.

props.name: role
props.description: Optionally set to region when the panel should be a landmark.
